description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the Banner module controller in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages the display of banner images within the store's extension modules by fetching banner data, processing images, and rendering a view template.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the banner module in the OpenCart catalog extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that generates and returns the banner module HTML, fetching banners based on provided settings and preparing data for the view.
